scenery.name: floor

scenery.name: sign

scenery.name: curtains

rooms.name: Medical Center Hub
rooms.description:
The room is lit by a number of dull florescent lights hanging overhead showing a dirty floor and sagging water soaked plaster walls. What was once a bright center for healing appears to be slowly decaying with time. There is a sign on the west wall above a curtained door.
A marked archway up returns to the Travel Concourse.

scenery.name: light
description: The florescent lights flicker faintly illuminating the dirty room. They appear to run on the buildings main power supply.

scenery.name: floor
description: The floor is tiled with misplaced and broken tiles showing years of decay.

scenery.name: sign
description: A small backlit sign on the wall. To read it, 'read sign'.

scenery.name: wall
description: The plaster walls are chipped and threatening to fall as time has slowly destroyed them.

scenery.name: curtain
description: The parted curtains were once sterile white are now torn and threadbare showing an exit to the west.
